# Three.js 0.180.0 (r180)

Self-hosted, unmodified ES modules from the official Three.js repository:

- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r180/build/three.module.js
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r180/build/three.core.js
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r180/LICENSE

`three.module.js` imports `three.core.js` from this directory. No CDN request,
package manager, build step, or additional runtime dependency is required.
The MIT license is reproduced in `LICENSE.txt`.
